title: Social Issues and Social Movements in Telangana
scope: Author-side primary-statute verification of three existing original practice MCQs, preserving all 30 and six mains

option_audit.A: INCORRECT: RTE section 5 regulates school transfers, not child-marriage injunctions
option_audit.B: CORRECT: PCMA section 13 authorises a judicial preventive injunction
option_audit.C: INCORRECT: Bonded Labour Abolition Act section 4 abolishes bonded labour
option_audit.D: INCORRECT: Constitution Article 17 abolishes untouchability, not child-marriage injunctions

option_audit.A: INCORRECT: PCMA section 3 generally provides voidability, not automatic nullity
option_audit.B: INCORRECT: PCMA section 3 does not require a prior criminal conviction to petition
option_audit.C: CORRECT: PCMA sections 3,12,14 distinguish voidable and specified void situations
option_audit.D: INCORRECT: section 3 grants the child party the annulment option, not only the adult party

option_audit.A: CORRECT: RTE section 5(3) transfer-certificate delay cannot by itself block admission
option_audit.B: INCORRECT: RTE section 5 does not require permanent destination-State residence
option_audit.C: INCORRECT: RTE section 5(2) expressly covers interstate transfer
option_audit.D: INCORRECT: section 5(3) expressly bars delay/denial on that ground
